description: Options for reviewing English passive constructions without a mandatory recurring software payment for the reviewed access path. Compare the bounded task of inspecting feedback, manually revising and rechecking against Grammarly Pro capability. Not a complete Grammarly or automatic rewrite replacement; account, usage limits and service conditions apply.

candidates.name: Hemingway Editor — Free Web
candidates.shortDescription: Browser-based English readability and passive-construction highlights for manual editing.
candidates.relationship: A bounded alternative to reviewing personal English passive constructions with Grammarly Pro: inspect feedback, choose a manual revision and recheck. Not an equivalent automatic rewrite or full grammar replacement. Owner Grammarly access was a limited Pro sample, not a paid Pro session.
candidates.pricingModel: Free browser editor for the reviewed highlighting/manual-edit workflow. Plus AI rewriting and paid Classic desktop are separate editions; no permanent availability guarantee.
candidates.tradeOffSummary: Passive highlights support manual review; no automatic rewrite, complete grammar, accuracy, offline or privacy parity. Existing dated before/after observations apply only to free web.
